basic_info.description: Experience the zenith of urban luxury in Mission Bay from this exceptional 5th-floor, corner residence. This rare 2-bed, 2-bath home presents breathtaking panoramic views and an expansive private terrace. Floor-to-ceiling windows throughout the living areas and bedrooms bathe the space in natural light, showcasing the remarkable views and creating an airy, cosmopolitan ambiance. The primary suite includes a luxurious en-suite bath and a spacious walk-in closet, and the guest bedroom features its own private terrace. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry, 1 car on-site parking with an EV charger, extra storage on the same floor, and an on-site building manager.  Perfectly situated in the vibrant heart of Mission Bay, this location offers effortless access to iconic landmarks like Oracle Park and Chase Center, scenic escapes along Mission Creek and Crane Cove Park, the bustling Embarcadero, and a diverse array of dining and entertainment options.
